decisions.reason: The margin analysis still has its own page and extends the established market-data offer, so in a growing industry it plausibly meets aspirations and gives no cause for problemistic search.
The gas tariff comparison is core-adjacent and draws on the maintained databases at low marginal cost, so slack readily carries it.
The regional electricity tariff calculator fits the central platform strategy and shows no visible shortfall against aspirations.
The tariff calculator line is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with C, so consolidation is possible after F's withdrawal, but its low cost and several models still favour keeping it.
The area definition tool complements the location-based products and integrates into the platform, so its value comes from supporting the other offerings.
